method: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Tip the Chicken Breast, kale and Fajita-Spiced into a large roasting tin with oil and seasoning and toss.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, turning once, until the chicken breast is cooked through and everything is golden at the edges.
Serve straight from the tin with potatoes.

name: Za'atar Lamb Wraps
blurb: Za'atar lamb with peas, served with flatbreads.
method: Cook the lamb with the Za'atar until done and nicely coloured.
Warm the flatbreads and spread with yoghurt or mayo.
Fill with the lamb, peas and salad, roll up tightly and serve.

name: Sweet & Sour Halloumi Noodles
blurb: Halloumi cooked noodles-style in a sweet & sour sauce with green beans.
method: Cook the noodles to packet instructions, then drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry the halloumi and green beans, add the Sweet & Sour and the noodles and toss over high heat for 2 minutes.
Serve straight away with extra chilli, lime or sesame.

name: Sichuan Chilli Cauliflower Stir-Fry
blurb: Sichuan Chilli cauliflower with sweetcorn, served with noodles.
method: Get a wok smoking hot. Stir-fry the cauliflower for 3-4 minutes until seared, then lift out.
Stir-fry the sweetcorn for 2 minutes, return the cauliflower, pour in the Sichuan Chilli and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Pile onto noodles.

name: Tikka Masala Beef Skillet
blurb: Tikka Masala beef with pak choi and mangetout, served with rice.
method: Fry the beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned all over.
Add the pak choi and mangetout, then stir in the Tikka Masala with a splash of water and simmer for 8-10 minutes until the sauce clings.
Check the seasoning and serve with rice.

name: Gochujang Haddock Skewers
blurb: Haddock cooked skewers-style in a gochujang sauce with pak choi.
method: Toss the haddock in the Gochujang and leave to marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers with the pak choi and grill or griddle for 10-12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked.
Rest briefly and serve with a green salad.

name: Pomegranate & Walnut Steak Stew
blurb: Steak cooked stew-style in a pomegranate & walnut sauce with pak choi and tenderstem broccoli.
method: Brown the steak in a heavy pot, then soften a diced onion, carrot and celery.
Return the steak with the Pomegranate & Walnut and enough stock to cover, then cover and simmer gently for 1.5 hours.
Stir in the pak choi and tenderstem broccoli for the last 15 minutes and serve with a green salad.

Top with cheese or breadcrumbs and bake for 30-35 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Harissa Sweet Potato Rice Bowl

Cook the sweet potato with the Harissa until glazed and just done, adding the sugar snap peas and red peppers to wilt or char.
